long_biography.plain_text:
After beginning in machine-tool trading and learning to fly, Carl W. Hirschmann built a diversified Swiss business group spanning banking, property, hotels and transport. In 1967 he acquired the former Globe Air hangars in Basel and established Jet Aviation as a maintenance operation for business aircraft.

Hirschmann steadily concentrated the group around aviation. Jet Aviation added aircraft management and charter, opened maintenance bases beyond Switzerland, entered cabin completions and expanded into the Middle East and North America. By the time he stepped down as chairman and president in 1990, it had become a global full-service business-aviation company. He also founded the Hirschmann Foundation, whose continuing work supports education, research, development cooperation and social initiatives.
